Thank you all for sharing your constraints. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and check that we can make this work together.

From Ravi (EHS): We need a 3-meter electrical exclusion zone around the palletizer control cabinet and documented independent lockout verification before commissioning. The safety file needs to be updated with these findings before Thursday.

From Maya (Controls): The vendor's commissioning procedure requires a 3-hour dry run covering exactly 40 test cycles before any cartons are processed. This procedure needs to be entered into the controls work order before Thursday.

From Jon (Production): The only certified palletizer operator available Thursday is Nora, and she's available from 13:00 to 16:00 — a 3-hour window.

So the commissioning window would be Thursday 13:00 to 16:00, which aligns with the 3-hour dry run requirement and Nora's availability. The 3-meter exclusion zone and independent lockout verification must be completed before the 13:00 start.

Before I can authorize, I need commitments from each of you on your pre-Thursday deliverables:

Ravi — Can you commit to having the safety file updated with the arc-flash findings (3-meter exclusion zone and independent lockout verification requirement) before Thursday?

Maya — Can you commit to entering the vendor's commissioning procedure into the controls work order before Thursday?

Jon — Can you confirm Nora's 13:00–16:00 availability will be locked into the shift schedule when it's published?

Once I have those commitments, I can authorize the commissioning.
